summary: Building regulated-gaming platforms end to end, from service design to production support.
bullets: Designed and shipped Spring Boot microservices for regulated gaming workloads, defining service boundaries, API contracts and data ownership for each domain.
Built event-driven flows on Apache Kafka and RabbitMQ, and real-time state synchronisation over WebSocket/STOMP so connected clients stay consistent without polling.
Cut read latency and database load with Redis caching and JPA/Hibernate tuning: fetch strategy, batch sizing, projections and query plan review.
Developed Angular and React single-page applications against those services, using lazy loading and code splitting to keep initial load lean.
Automated build, test and deployment with CI/CD pipelines, containerising services with Docker and running them on Kubernetes.
Owned features end to end: HLD/LLD, implementation, code review, secure coding against the OWASP Top 10, testing and production support.

summary: Backend internship focused on REST APIs, persistence and tests.
bullets: Built REST APIs with Spring Boot against agreed request/response contracts.
Implemented persistence layers with Spring Data JPA, including entity mapping and repository queries.
Wrote unit tests to cover service and repository logic ahead of integration.
